tasks.label: Find Node installation
tasks.command: $paths = @('C:\Program Files','C:\Program Files (x86)','$env:USERPROFILE\AppData\Local'); foreach ($p in $paths) { if (Test-Path $p) { Get-ChildItem -Path $p -Filter node.exe -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 20 -ExpandProperty FullName } }
